description: Get the canonical apply info for one live role, plus a join_url where the candidate can join the a16z speedrun talent network by entering their own details on the site. Takes only a job id: it records no personal data, attaches nothing to any profile, and submits nothing anywhere. apply.kind 'onsite' means the candidate applies on the returned job url; 'external' means the url hands off to the company's own careers page. Relay both the apply url and the join_url to the candidate; they act on each themselves. Safe to retry.

agent_client_id.description: Identifier for the calling agent/integration, e.g. "claude-code". Attribution only.

job_id.description: Job UUID, 8-hex id prefix, or canonical job slug (same ids as get_job/search_jobs).
